    --bg:#eeece6; --surface:#f8f6f2; --surface-2:#ffffff;
    --bg-trans:rgba(238,236,230,.78);
    --line:rgba(20,24,28,.11); --line-2:rgba(20,24,28,.22);
    --text:#171b1f; --dim:#566069; --mute:#5f6772;
    --accent:#0e7d76; --accent-dim:#34b3ac; --on-accent:#ffffff;
    --logo-light:#2b3138; --glow:rgba(14,125,118,.12);
    --jci-fill:rgba(20,24,28,.10); --jci-line:rgba(20,24,28,.34); --fear:#c1454b;
    --elev:0 16px 40px -28px rgba(20,24,28,.30); --elev-hi:0 26px 56px -28px rgba(20,24,28,.34);
    color-scheme:light;
  }

  html[data-kp-root]{background:var(--bg);}
  body{
    min-height:100vh; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text);
    font-family:var(--sans); -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
  }
  [data-kp-root] *{transition:background-color .3s ease,color .3s ease,border-color .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease,transform .25s ease;}
  ::selection{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);}
  a{color:inherit;}

  /* keyboard focus (a11y) */
  :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px;}
  .tool-card:focus-visible,.app-row:focus-visible,.social-cell:focus-visible{outline-offset:-2px;}
  .btn:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.985);}

  /* first-load reveal: visible by default, animates from a hidden start */
  @keyframes kp-rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}}
  .reveal{animation:kp-rise .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) backwards;}

  @keyframes kp-ticker{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
  @keyframes kp-blink{0%,49%{opacity:1}50%,100%{opacity:0}}

  /* ---- logo mark (the exact ascending-bars mark, theme-aware) ---- */
  .kp-logo{display:block;width:auto;}
  .kp-logo .bar-accent{fill:var(--logo-teal);}
  .kp-logo .bar-light{fill:var(--logo-light);}

  .wrap{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 32px;}

  .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--dim);}
  .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;background:var(--accent);display:inline-block;flex:none;}

  /* ---- buttons ---- */
  .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:.1em;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;border:0;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap;}
  .btn--primary{color:var(--on-accent);background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 14px 34px -14px var(--accent);}
  .btn--primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 20px 44px -14px var(--accent);}
  .btn--ghost{color:var(--text);background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line-2);}
  .btn--ghost:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);}

  /* ---- header ---- */
  header.site{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;background:var(--bg-trans);
    backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .header-inner{height:70px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;}
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;}
  .brand .name{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;}
  nav.main{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;}
  .nav-link{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--dim);
    text-decoration:none;padding:9px 15px;}
  .nav-link:hover{color:var(--text);}
  .toggle{width:40px;height:40px;font-size:14px;color:var(--dim);
    background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:0;margin-left:8px;cursor:pointer;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:transform .13s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),color .15s ease,border-color .15s ease;}
  .toggle:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--line-2);}
  .toggle:active{transform:scale(.97);}

  /* ---- ticker ---- */
  .ticker{overflow:hidden;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);
    -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 7%,#000 93%,transparent);
    mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 7%,#000 93%,transparent);}
  .ticker-track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:kp-ticker 44s linear infinite;
    font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--mute);white-space:nowrap;}
  .ticker-group{display:flex;}
  .ticker-group span{padding:10px 30px;}
  .ticker-group .up{color:var(--accent);}
  .ticker-group .down{color:var(--fear);}
  .ticker-group .kp-jci b,.ticker-group .kp-fg b{font-weight:600;}
  .ticker-group .kp-jci:empty,.ticker-group .kp-fg:empty{display:none;}

  /* ---- hero ---- */
  .hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
  .hero-glow{position:absolute;top:-8%;right:-6%;width:680px;height:680px;
    background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--glow) 0%,transparent 62%);pointer-events:none;z-index:0;}
  .hero-grid{position:relative;z-index:1;padding:100px 32px 110px;display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1.04fr .96fr;gap:72px;align-items:center;}
  .hero-grid>*{min-width:0;}
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(44px,5.2vw,76px);line-height:1;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.025em;
    margin:0 0 30px;text-wrap:balance;}
  .hero h1 .accent{color:var(--accent);}
  .hero .lede{font-size:19px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--dim);max-width:31em;margin:0 0 16px;font-weight:300;}
  .hero .mono-note{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--mute);margin:0 0 42px;}
  .hero .cta{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .hero .cta .btn{padding:17px 28px;font-size:12px;}
  /* live-data quick links — a second way into the sentiment + heatmap sections */
  .hero-live{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px;}
  .hero-live .lbl{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--mute);}
  .live-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;
    letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--dim);text-decoration:none;padding:8px 13px;
    border:1px solid var(--line-2);transition:border-color .18s,color .18s,transform .18s;}
  .live-chip:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--text);transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .live-chip .dot{width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--accent);display:inline-block;animation:kp-blink 1.6s steps(1) infinite;}
  .live-chip .arr{color:var(--mute);transition:color .18s,transform .18s;}
  .live-chip:hover .arr{color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(2px);}

  /* ---- terminal card ---- */
  .terminal{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line-2);background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--elev);}

    border-top:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;color:inherit;font-family:var(--mono);}

  /* ---- apps section ---- */
  .section{border-top:1px solid var(--line);}

  .tool-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--line-2);box-shadow:var(--elev-hi);}
  .tool-viz{height:196px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);padding:24px;overflow:hidden;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;}
  .tool-viz .viz-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--mute);}
  .tool-body{padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:13px;flex:1;}
  .tool-body .row1{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:13px;}
  .tool-body .num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--accent);}
  .tool-body h3{font-size:24px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0;}
  .tool-body p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.56;color:var(--dim);margin:0;font-weight:300;flex:1;}
  .tool-body .foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-top:14px;
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.04em;}
  .tool-body .foot .url{color:var(--mute);}
  .tool-body .foot .open{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;}

  .bars{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:5px;height:64px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .bars span{width:7px;}
  .meter-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--dim);}
  .meter{flex:1;background:var(--line);}
  .meter > span{display:block;background:var(--accent);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}

  /* ---- live charts (looping motion) ---- */
  @keyframes kp-eq{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(.5)}50%{transform:scaleY(1)}}
  @keyframes kp-eq2{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(.84)}50%{transform:scaleY(1)}}

  @keyframes kp-stripe{to{background-position:8.49px 0}}
  .bars span{transform-origin:bottom;animation:kp-eq 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;}
  .bars span:nth-child(2){animation-duration:1.9s;animation-delay:-.5s}
  .bars span:nth-child(3){animation-duration:1.2s;animation-delay:-.3s}
  .bars span:nth-child(4){animation-duration:1.7s;animation-delay:-.8s}
  .bars span:nth-child(5){animation-duration:1.35s;animation-delay:-.2s}
  .bars span:nth-child(6){animation-duration:2s;animation-delay:-.6s}
  .bars span:nth-child(7){animation-duration:1.45s;animation-delay:-.9s}
  .bars span:nth-child(8){animation-duration:1.8s;animation-delay:-.15s}
  .bars span:nth-child(9){animation-duration:1.25s;animation-delay:-.7s}
  .bars span:nth-child(10){animation-duration:1.6s;animation-delay:-.4s}
  .bars span:nth-child(11){animation-duration:1.4s;animation-delay:-.55s}
  .ipo-bars span{transform-origin:bottom;animation:kp-eq2 2.6s ease-in-out infinite;}

  .ipo-bars span:nth-child(4){animation-duration:2.8s;animation-delay:-.9s}

  .ipo-bars span:nth-child(6){animation:kp-eq 1.9s ease-in-out infinite}
  .meter>span::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.26),transparent);transform:translateX(-120%);animation:kp-flow 2.8s ease-in-out infinite;}
  .meter-row:nth-child(2) .meter>span::after{animation-delay:-.9s}
  .meter-row:nth-child(3) .meter>span::after{animation-delay:-1.6s}
  .meter-row:nth-child(4) .meter>span::after{animation-delay:-2.2s}
  .ff-fill{position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
  .ff-fill::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.3),transparent);transform:translateX(-120%);animation:kp-flow 3s ease-in-out infinite;}
  .ff-locked{animation:kp-stripe .9s linear infinite;}

  /* ---- community ---- */
  .floor-grid{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--elev);
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;overflow:hidden;}
  .floor-main{padding:56px 52px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
  .floor-glow{position:absolute;top:-30%;left:-10%;width:420px;height:420px;

  .floor-main h2 .accent{color:var(--accent);}
  .floor-main p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--dim);max-width:30em;margin:0 0 38px;font-weight:300;}
  .floor-main .btn{padding:18px 30px;font-size:13px;}
  .floor-social{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-left:1px solid var(--line);}
  .social-cell{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:9px;padding:40px 44px;
    text-decoration:none;color:inherit;}
  .social-cell + .social-cell{border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .social-cell:hover{background:var(--surface-2);}
  .social-cell .top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;}
  .social-cell .top .k{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--mute);}
  .social-cell .top .arr{color:var(--accent);font-size:18px;}
  .social-cell .handle{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:25px;font-weight:500;}

  /* ---- footer ---- */
  footer.site{border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .footer-inner{padding:40px 32px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .footer-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;}
  .footer-brand .copy{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--dim);}
  .footer-links{display:flex;gap:24px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;}
  .footer-links a{color:var(--mute);text-decoration:none;}
  .footer-links a:hover{color:var(--text);}

  /* ---- market sentiment (Fear & Greed) ---- */
  .fg-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,344px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:22px;align-items:stretch;}
  .fg-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border:1px solid var(--line-2);
    background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--elev);}
  .fg-card .terminal-head .fg-head-meta{color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:.06em;}

  .fg-meter-body{padding:32px 28px 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
    justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;flex:1;}
  .fg-gaugewrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;}
  .fg-gauge{width:100%;max-width:236px;height:auto;display:block;overflow:visible;}
  .fg-gauge .g-end{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;fill:var(--mute);}
  .fg-val{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:62px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-top:8px;color:var(--fear);}
  .fg-cls{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;margin-top:11px;color:var(--fear);}
  .fg-asof{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--mute);margin-top:10px;}
  .fg-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;
    padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .fg-stats > div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;text-align:center;}
  .fg-stats span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--mute);}
  .fg-stats b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:18px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);}

  .fg-chart-body{padding:24px 22px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;position:relative;}
  .fg-chart{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;flex:1;overflow:visible;}
  .fg-chart .ax{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;fill:var(--mute);}
  .fg-chart .ax-l{text-anchor:end;}
  .fg-chart .ax-r{text-anchor:start;}
  .fg-chart .ax-x{text-anchor:middle;}
  .fg-chart .ax-x-first{text-anchor:start;}
  .fg-chart .ax-x-last{text-anchor:end;}
  .fg-area{fill:var(--jci-fill);}
  .fg-jline{stroke:var(--jci-line);stroke-width:1;fill:none;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;}
  .fg-line{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2.4;fill:none;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;}
  .fg-dot{fill:var(--accent);stroke:var(--surface);stroke-width:2;}
  .fg-legend{display:flex;gap:28px;justify-content:center;margin-top:8px;
    font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--dim);}
  .fg-legend i{display:inline-block;width:15px;height:10px;margin-right:8px;vertical-align:middle;}
  .fg-legend .sw-jci{background:var(--jci-line);opacity:.55;}
  .fg-legend .sw-fg{height:3px;background:var(--accent);}

  /* ---- idx movers (leaders/laggards contribution board) ---- */
  /* Market pulse runs wider than the reading column: the treemap and a 6-column
     table both buy real legibility from the extra width. Capped rather than
     full-bleed so it still reads as a page, not a dashboard. */
  .wrap--wide{max-width:1680px;}
  .mp-asof{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--mute);
    margin:0 0 10px;text-transform:uppercase;}
  .mv-card{border:1px solid var(--line-2);background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--elev);margin-bottom:18px;}
  .mv-card .terminal-head .fg-head-meta{color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:.06em;}
  .mv-range{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;margin-right:14px;}
  .mv-range-btn{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;padding:3px 10px;
    background:none;border:1px solid var(--line-2);color:var(--dim);cursor:pointer;}
  .mv-range-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);}
  .mv-range-btn.active{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);border-color:var(--accent);}
  .mv-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 22px;align-items:baseline;padding:12px 20px;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dim);}
  .mv-strip b{color:var(--text);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;}
  .mv-net.up,.mv-strip .up{color:var(--accent);}
  .mv-net.down,.mv-strip .down{color:var(--fear);}
  .mv-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .mv-col{min-width:0;}
  .mv-col+.mv-col{border-left:1px solid var(--line);}
  .mv-col-head{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;padding:10px 20px;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .mv-col-head--up{color:var(--accent);}
  .mv-col-head--down{color:var(--fear);}
  .mv-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;}
  .mv-table th{font-weight:400;color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:.08em;font-size:10px;text-align:left;
    padding:8px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap;}
  .mv-table th.num,.mv-table td.num{text-align:right;}
  .mv-table td{padding:7px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--dim);white-space:nowrap;}
  .mv-table th:first-child,.mv-table td:first-child{padding-left:20px;}
  .mv-table th:last-child,.mv-table td:last-child{padding-right:20px;}
  .mv-table td.tk{color:var(--text);font-weight:600;}
  .mv-table td.rank{color:var(--mute);width:30px;}
  .mv-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
  .mv-table .pos{color:var(--accent);}
  .mv-table .neg{color:var(--fear);}
  .mv-count{color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:.06em;}
  .mv-search{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
    background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:2px;color:var(--text);
    padding:4px 8px;width:120px;outline:none;}
  .mv-search::placeholder{color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:.1em;}
  .mv-search:focus{border-color:var(--accent);}
  .mv-search::-webkit-search-cancel-button{filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.5;}
  /* Scroll the rows, not the page: the header stays pinned so a sorted column

  .mv-scroll{max-height:440px;overflow-y:auto;}
  .mv-table thead th{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1;background:var(--surface);}
  .mv-table th[data-sort]{cursor:pointer;user-select:none;}
  .mv-table th[data-sort]:hover{color:var(--text);}
  .mv-table th[data-sort]::after{content:'';opacity:0;}
  .mv-table th[data-sort].asc::after{content:' ▲';opacity:1;font-size:8px;}
  .mv-table th[data-sort].desc::after{content:' ▼';opacity:1;font-size:8px;}
  .mv-empty{padding:14px 20px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);}

  .hm-legend{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin-top:15px;

  /* heatmap toolbar: fullscreen + save-image */
  .hm-head-right{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;}
  .hm-tools{display:inline-flex;gap:6px;}
  .hm-tool{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:30px;height:25px;padding:0;

  .hm-tool:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);}
  .hm-tool:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default;}

  .kp-shot-wrap{position:relative;display:inline-flex;}

  .hm-card:fullscreen #hm-wrap{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;}

  .hm-crumb .hm-crumb-back{color:var(--accent);}
  .hm-crumb.on:hover .hm-crumb-back{text-decoration:underline;}
  .hm-hint{color:var(--mute);}
  /* hover panel: the hovered tile's sub-sector peers, with sparklines */

  .hm-panel.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;} /* interactive so the list can scroll */
  .hm-panel-head{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--dim);padding:9px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .hm-feat{padding:9px 12px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .hm-feat .hm-row{font-size:14px;padding:0;}
  .hm-feat .hm-row-t{flex:none;width:auto;min-width:48px;}
  .hm-feat-name{color:var(--mute);font-size:10px;margin-top:6px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
  .hm-list{padding:3px 0;max-height:280px;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;
    scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--line-2) transparent;}
  .hm-list::-webkit-scrollbar{width:7px;}
  .hm-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--line-2);border-radius:4px;}
  .hm-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:4px 12px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.4;}

<style>
  @font-face{font-family:"Space Grotesk";font-style:normal;font-weight:300 700;font-display:swap;src:url("assets/fonts/space-grotesk.woff2") format("woff2");}
  @font-face{font-family:"JetBrains Mono";font-style:normal;font-weight:400 700;font-display:swap;src:url("assets/fonts/jetbrains-mono.woff2") format("woff2");}
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  html{scroll-padding-top:90px;}

  [data-kp-root]{
    --bg:#13171b; --surface:#181d23; --surface-2:#1e242b;
    --bg-trans:rgba(19,23,27,.78);
    --line:rgba(232,237,240,.10); --line-2:rgba(232,237,240,.20);
    --text:#e9ecef; --dim:#9aa3ab; --mute:#7e8893;
    --accent:#3bbcb4; --accent-dim:#1f7d77; --on-accent:#06130f;
    --logo-light:#d8d8d8; --logo-teal:#33b2ab; --glow:rgba(59,188,180,.16);
    --jci-fill:rgba(154,163,171,.14); --jci-line:rgba(154,163,171,.50); --fear:#d2565b;
    --elev:0 18px 46px -26px rgba(0,0,0,.62); --elev-hi:0 28px 64px -28px rgba(0,0,0,.72);
    --mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;
    --sans:"Space Grotesk",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;
    color-scheme:dark;
  }
  [data-kp-root][data-theme="light"]{
    --bg:#eeece6; --surface:#f8f6f2; --surface-2:#ffffff;
    --bg-trans:rgba(238,236,230,.78);
    --line:rgba(20,24,28,.11); --line-2:rgba(20,24,28,.22);
    --text:#171b1f; --dim:#566069; --mute:#5f6772;
    --accent:#0e7d76; --accent-dim:#34b3ac; --on-accent:#ffffff;
    --logo-light:#2b3138; --glow:rgba(14,125,118,.12);
    --jci-fill:rgba(20,24,28,.10); --jci-line:rgba(20,24,28,.34); --fear:#c1454b;
    --elev:0 16px 40px -28px rgba(20,24,28,.30); --elev-hi:0 26px 56px -28px rgba(20,24,28,.34);
    color-scheme:light;
  }

  html[data-kp-root]{background:var(--bg);}
  body{
    min-height:100vh; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text);
    font-family:var(--sans); -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
  }
  [data-kp-root] *{transition:background-color .3s ease,color .3s ease,border-color .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease,transform .25s ease;}
  ::selection{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent);}
  a{color:inherit;}

  /* keyboard focus (a11y) */
  :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px;}
  .tool-card:focus-visible,.app-row:focus-visible,.social-cell:focus-visible{outline-offset:-2px;}
  .btn:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.985);}

  /* first-load reveal: visible by default, animates from a hidden start */
  @keyframes kp-rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}}
  .reveal{animation:kp-rise .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) backwards;}

  @keyframes kp-ticker{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
  @keyframes kp-blink{0%,49%{opacity:1}50%,100%{opacity:0}}

  /* ---- logo mark (the exact ascending-bars mark, theme-aware) ---- */
  .kp-logo{display:block;width:auto;}
  .kp-logo .bar-accent{fill:var(--logo-teal);}
  .kp-logo .bar-light{fill:var(--logo-light);}

  .wrap{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 32px;}

  .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--dim);}
  .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;background:var(--accent);display:inline-block;flex:none;}

  /* ---- buttons ---- */
  .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:.1em;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;border:0;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap;}
  .btn--primary{color:var(--on-accent);background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 14px 34px -14px var(--accent);}
  .btn--primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 20px 44px -14px var(--accent);}
  .btn--ghost{color:var(--text);background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line-2);}
  .btn--ghost:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);}

  /* ---- header ---- */
  header.site{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;background:var(--bg-trans);
    backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .header-inner{height:70px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;}
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;}
  .brand .name{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;}
  nav.main{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;}
  .nav-link{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--dim);
    text-decoration:none;padding:9px 15px;}
  .nav-link:hover{color:var(--text);}
  .toggle{width:40px;height:40px;font-size:14px;color:var(--dim);
    background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:0;margin-left:8px;cursor:pointer;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:transform .13s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),color .15s ease,border-color .15s ease;}
  .toggle:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--line-2);}
  .toggle:active{transform:scale(.97);}

  /* ---- ticker ---- */
  .ticker{overflow:hidden;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);
    -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 7%,#000 93%,transparent);
    mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 7%,#000 93%,transparent);}
  .ticker-track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:kp-ticker 44s linear infinite;
    font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--mute);white-space:nowrap;}
  .ticker-group{display:flex;}
  .ticker-group span{padding:10px 30px;}
  .ticker-group .up{color:var(--accent);}
  .ticker-group .down{color:var(--fear);}
  .ticker-group .kp-jci b,.ticker-group .kp-fg b{font-weight:600;}
  .ticker-group .kp-jci:empty,.ticker-group .kp-fg:empty{display:none;}

  /* ---- hero ---- */
  .hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
  .hero-glow{position:absolute;top:-8%;right:-6%;width:680px;height:680px;
    background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--glow) 0%,transparent 62%);pointer-events:none;z-index:0;}
  .hero-grid{position:relative;z-index:1;padding:100px 32px 110px;display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1.04fr .96fr;gap:72px;align-items:center;}
  .hero-grid>*{min-width:0;}
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(44px,5.2vw,76px);line-height:1;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.025em;
    margin:0 0 30px;text-wrap:balance;}
  .hero h1 .accent{color:var(--accent);}
  .hero .lede{font-size:19px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--dim);max-width:31em;margin:0 0 16px;font-weight:300;}
  .hero .mono-note{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--mute);margin:0 0 42px;}
  .hero .cta{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .hero .cta .btn{padding:17px 28px;font-size:12px;}
  /* live-data quick links — a second way into the sentiment + heatmap sections */
  .hero-live{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px;}
  .hero-live .lbl{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--mute);}
  .live-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;
    letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--dim);text-decoration:none;padding:8px 13px;
    border:1px solid var(--line-2);transition:border-color .18s,color .18s,transform .18s;}
  .live-chip:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--text);transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .live-chip .dot{width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--accent);display:inline-block;animation:kp-blink 1.6s steps(1) infinite;}
  .live-chip .arr{color:var(--mute);transition:color .18s,transform .18s;}
  .live-chip:hover .arr{color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(2px);}

  /* ---- terminal card ---- */
  .terminal{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line-2);background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--elev);}
  .terminal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:14px 20px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--dim);}
  .terminal-head .live{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;}
  .terminal-head .live .dot{width:7px;height:7px;background:var(--accent);display:inline-block;animation:kp-blink 1.6s steps(1) infinite;}
  .terminal-body{padding:38px 28px 24px;}
  .terminal-logo{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:36px;}
  .app-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 8px;
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;color:inherit;font-family:var(--mono);}
  .app-row:last-of-type{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .app-row:hover{background:var(--surface-2);}
  .app-row .tag{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--mute);width:54px;}
  .app-row .label{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:16px;font-weight:500;flex:1;}
  .app-row .arr{color:var(--accent);}
  .terminal-prompt{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);margin-top:20px;letter-spacing:.06em;}
  .terminal-prompt .caret{animation:kp-blink 1.2s steps(1) infinite;}

  /* ---- apps section ---- */
  .section{border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .section-inner{padding:92px 32px 100px;}
  .apps-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:40px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:52px;}
  .apps-head h2{font-size:clamp(34px,3.8vw,50px);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:22px 0 0;}
  .apps-head .intro{font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--dim);max-width:30em;margin:0;font-weight:300;}
  .apps-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:22px;}

  .tool-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);
    box-shadow:var(--elev);text-decoration:none;color:inherit;}
  .tool-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--line-2);box-shadow:var(--elev-hi);}
  .tool-viz{height:196px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);padding:24px;overflow:hidden;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;}
  .tool-viz .viz-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--mute);}
  .tool-body{padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:13px;flex:1;}
  .tool-body .row1{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:13px;}
  .tool-body .num{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--accent);}
  .tool-body h3{font-size:24px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0;}
  .tool-body p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.56;color:var(--dim);margin:0;font-weight:300;flex:1;}
  .tool-body .foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-top:14px;
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.04em;}
  .tool-body .foot .url{color:var(--mute);}
  .tool-body .foot .open{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;}

  .bars{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:5px;height:64px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .bars span{width:7px;}
  .meter-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--dim);}
  .meter{flex:1;background:var(--line);}
  .meter > span{display:block;background:var(--accent);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}

  /* ---- live charts (looping motion) ---- */
  @keyframes kp-eq{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(.5)}50%{transform:scaleY(1)}}
  @keyframes kp-eq2{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(.84)}50%{transform:scaleY(1)}}
  @keyframes kp-flow{0%{transform:translateX(-120%)}55%,100%{transform:translateX(240%)}}
  @keyframes kp-stripe{to{background-position:8.49px 0}}
  .bars span{transform-origin:bottom;animation:kp-eq 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;}
  .bars span:nth-child(2){animation-duration:1.9s;animation-delay:-.5s}
  .bars span:nth-child(3){animation-duration:1.2s;animation-delay:-.3s}
  .bars span:nth-child(4){animation-duration:1.7s;animation-delay:-.8s}
  .bars span:nth-child(5){animation-duration:1.35s;animation-delay:-.2s}
  .bars span:nth-child(6){animation-duration:2s;animation-delay:-.6s}
  .bars span:nth-child(7){animation-duration:1.45s;animation-delay:-.9s}
  .bars span:nth-child(8){animation-duration:1.8s;animation-delay:-.15s}
  .bars span:nth-child(9){animation-duration:1.25s;animation-delay:-.7s}
  .bars span:nth-child(10){animation-duration:1.6s;animation-delay:-.4s}
  .bars span:nth-child(11){animation-duration:1.4s;animation-delay:-.55s}
  .ipo-bars span{transform-origin:bottom;animation:kp-eq2 2.6s ease-in-out infinite;}
  .ipo-bars span:nth-child(2){animation-duration:3s;animation-delay:-.6s}
  .ipo-bars span:nth-child(3){animation-duration:2.3s;animation-delay:-.3s}
  .ipo-bars span:nth-child(4){animation-duration:2.8s;animation-delay:-.9s}
  .ipo-bars span:nth-child(5){animation-duration:2.5s;animation-delay:-.4s}
  .ipo-bars span:nth-child(6){animation:kp-eq 1.9s ease-in-out infinite}
  .meter>span::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.26),transparent);transform:translateX(-120%);animation:kp-flow 2.8s ease-in-out infinite;}
  .meter-row:nth-child(2) .meter>span::after{animation-delay:-.9s}
  .meter-row:nth-child(3) .meter>span::after{animation-delay:-1.6s}
  .meter-row:nth-child(4) .meter>span::after{animation-delay:-2.2s}
  .ff-fill{position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
  .ff-fill::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.3),transparent);transform:translateX(-120%);animation:kp-flow 3s ease-in-out infinite;}
  .ff-locked{animation:kp-stripe .9s linear infinite;}

  /* ---- community ---- */
  .floor-grid{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--elev);
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;overflow:hidden;}
  .floor-main{padding:56px 52px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
  .floor-glow{position:absolute;top:-30%;left:-10%;width:420px;height:420px;
    background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--glow) 0%,transparent 64%);pointer-events:none;}
  .floor-main h2{font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,54px);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 22px;line-height:1.02;}
  .floor-main h2 .accent{color:var(--accent);}
  .floor-main p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--dim);max-width:30em;margin:0 0 38px;font-weight:300;}
  .floor-main .btn{padding:18px 30px;font-size:13px;}
  .floor-social{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-left:1px solid var(--line);}
  .social-cell{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:9px;padding:40px 44px;
    text-decoration:none;color:inherit;}
  .social-cell + .social-cell{border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .social-cell:hover{background:var(--surface-2);}
  .social-cell .top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;}
  .social-cell .top .k{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--mute);}
  .social-cell .top .arr{color:var(--accent);font-size:18px;}
  .social-cell .handle{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:25px;font-weight:500;}

  /* ---- footer ---- */
  footer.site{border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .footer-inner{padding:40px 32px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .footer-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;}
  .footer-brand .copy{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--dim);}
  .footer-links{display:flex;gap:24px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;}
  .footer-links a{color:var(--mute);text-decoration:none;}
  .footer-links a:hover{color:var(--text);}

  /* ---- market sentiment (Fear & Greed) ---- */
  .fg-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,344px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:22px;align-items:stretch;}
  .fg-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border:1px solid var(--line-2);
    background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--elev);}
  .fg-card .terminal-head .fg-head-meta{color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:.06em;}

  .fg-meter-body{padding:32px 28px 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
    justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;flex:1;}
  .fg-gaugewrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;}
  .fg-gauge{width:100%;max-width:236px;height:auto;display:block;overflow:visible;}
  .fg-gauge .g-end{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;fill:var(--mute);}
  .fg-val{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:62px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-top:8px;color:var(--fear);}
  .fg-cls{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;margin-top:11px;color:var(--fear);}
  .fg-asof{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--mute);margin-top:10px;}
  .fg-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;
    padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .fg-stats > div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;text-align:center;}
  .fg-stats span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--mute);}
  .fg-stats b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:18px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);}

  .fg-chart-body{padding:24px 22px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;position:relative;}
  .fg-chart{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;flex:1;overflow:visible;}
  .fg-chart .ax{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;fill:var(--mute);}
  .fg-chart .ax-l{text-anchor:end;}
  .fg-chart .ax-r{text-anchor:start;}
  .fg-chart .ax-x{text-anchor:middle;}
  .fg-chart .ax-x-first{text-anchor:start;}
  .fg-chart .ax-x-last{text-anchor:end;}
  .fg-area{fill:var(--jci-fill);}
  .fg-jline{stroke:var(--jci-line);stroke-width:1;fill:none;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;}
  .fg-line{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2.4;fill:none;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;}
  .fg-dot{fill:var(--accent);stroke:var(--surface);stroke-width:2;}
